menus.note: Pairing of four glasses of wine; plus 10% service and 7% VAT

menus.name: Samrub Thai dinner set
menus.note: Snacks and small dishes, then a traditional shared Thai main course with rice and dessert; plus 10% service and 7% VAT

menus.name: Samrub Thai lunch set
menus.note: Starter, a choice of four mains and dessert; à la carte is also served at lunch; plus 10% service and 7% VAT

bookingOpens: Online through TableCheck for up to six guests, or by phone or email (info@sanehjaan.com). A deposit is taken when booking: THB 500 a person for lunch and THB 1,500 a person for the dinner tasting menu, taken off the bill on the day.
cancellation: Cancel or change more than 72 hours before the booking for a full refund of the deposit or a one-off move to another date. Within 72 hours, and for no-shows, the deposit is kept. Tables are held for 15 minutes.
groups: Parties of seven or more book by phone or email. The restaurant also caters for private events.
dressCode: Smart. No shorts or sleeveless shirts for men, no yoga pants or sportswear, and no slippers, sandals, flip-flops or open-toed shoes.
children: Children aged 6 and over only, except in a separate private area. There is no children's menu.
byob: Corkage is THB 1,500 plus service and VAT a bottle of wine, THB 3,000 a bottle of spirits.
